would schedule a fresh reconnect — and on WebTransport could trip
wsFailCount >= 3 and call redirectToLogin() from a transport the caller had
already discarded.

its now-discarded context but the deploy-list still shows 執行中 to
Phase 5's fresh browser. Passive polling won't help (the row would
never flip on its own).
